name: Brave Hound 66
author: Smit-Prajapati
description: Gradient pill light sky-blue text input that reacts on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border-left becomes 3px solid #ffffff. On focus, the outline is removed, background changes from linear-gradient(135deg, #dae8f7 0%, #d6e5f7 100%) to linear-gradient(135deg, #eff7ff 0%, #d6e5f7 100%).
